Please find attached our monthly supply order. We need everything delivered by Friday, November 7, because our new associates start work the following Monday. If any item is unavailable, please substitute a similar product of the same or lower price rather than delaying the order.
Thank you,
Linda Shaw, Office Manager

docs.text:

docs.title: E-mail · To: Linda Shaw · From: Office Mart · Date: November 4
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Shaw,
Thank you for your order. All items will be delivered on Thursday, November 6. Please note that the silver desk lamps are out of stock, so, as you requested, we have substituted white desk lamps from the same brand, which are $25.00 each. The difference has been taken off your invoice.
Best regards,
Office Mart Customer Service

qs.q: Why does Ms. Shaw need the order by November 7?
w: The firm is closing for a holiday.
qs.ev: our new associates start work the following Monday
qs.why: Nhân viên mới bắt đầu làm vào thứ Hai sau đó.

qs.q: What does Ms. Shaw ask the supplier to do if an item is unavailable?
qs.ev: please substitute a similar product of the same or lower price
qs.why: Thay bằng sản phẩm tương tự, giá bằng hoặc thấp hơn.

qs.q: How much will Corbin Law Firm save on the lamps in total?
qs.ev: which are $25.00 each
qs.why: Đèn bạc $28, đèn trắng $25 → rẻ hơn $3 mỗi cái × 4 cái = $12.

qs.q: When will the items be delivered?
qs.ev: All items will be delivered on Thursday, November 6.
qs.why: Giao ngày thứ Năm 6/11.

qs.q: What is suggested about the substitution?
w: It came from a different brand.
qs.ev: as you requested, we have substituted white desk lamps from the same brand
qs.why: Thay đèn rẻ hơn, cùng hãng, đúng như cô dặn trong e-mail đầu.

docs.text:
Laura Chen [9:15 A.M.]: Good morning, team. The Kensington proposal is due to the client on Thursday. Where are we?
Tom Becker [9:16 A.M.]: I've finished the budget section. I'll upload it this morning.
Aisha Rahman [9:18 A.M.]: The design mock-ups are almost done, but I still need the client's logo files.

qs.ev: The Kensington proposal is due to the client on Thursday.

qs.ev: I still need the client's logo files
qs.why: Cô cần tệp logo của khách hàng.

qs.q: What will happen on Wednesday?
qs.a: The team will review its work.
w: Mr. Becker will upload a budget.
qs.ev: Should we schedule a final review on Wednesday afternoon?
qs.why: Chiều thứ Tư họp duyệt lần cuối (Laura đặt phòng 4B lúc 2 giờ).

qs.q: At 9:31 A.M., what does Ms. Chen mean when she writes, "Perfect timing!"?
qs.a: She no longer needs to call the client.
w: She wants to move the meeting.
She has just arrived at the office.
She thinks the deadline is too early.

qs.why: Tệp logo vừa tới đúng lúc cô định gọi lại cho khách → không cần gọi nữa.

Nina Ross (10:02 A.M.): Hi, Sam. The client from Osaka just arrived in the lobby, but the conference room is still being cleaned.

qs.why: "Sure thing" = được thôi; anh nhận đưa khách lên văn phòng và mời cà phê như chị dặn.

docs.title: Old Mill Becomes Arts Center
docs.text: GRANVILLE — A 150-year-old flour mill on the Granville River will reopen next month as an arts center. [1] The building had been empty for nearly thirty years before a group of local artists bought it in 2023. [2] With the help of volunteers and a $1.2 million grant from the state, they restored the original brick walls and wooden beams. [3] The center will include eight artist studios, a gallery, and a café overlooking the river. [4] Classes in painting, pottery, and photography will be offered to the public starting in the fall. Director Joan Whitfield said the center will "give new life to the riverfront."

qs.q: What is the article mainly about?
qs.a: The conversion of an old building
w: A new art school in the state capital
qs.ev: will reopen next month as an arts center
qs.why: Cối xay bột cũ được biến thành trung tâm nghệ thuật.

qs.q: How was the restoration partly funded?
qs.ev: a $1.2 million grant from the state
qs.why: Có khoản tài trợ 1,2 triệu đô của bang.

qs.q: In the article, the word "restored" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: they restored the original brick walls and wooden beams
qs.why: restore = phục hồi, sửa lại như cũ (repaired).

qs.q: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Several of the studios have already been rented."
qs.why: "the studios" chỉ tám xưởng vẽ vừa nêu → câu chèn đứng ngay sau câu đó (vị trí [4]).

x.title: To: Valued Customers · From: FreshBox Meals · Subject: Holiday delivery schedule
x.text: Dear Customer, Because of the national holiday on Monday, May 26, our delivery schedule {1} next week. Boxes normally delivered on Monday will arrive on Tuesday instead. {2} If you will not be home on Tuesday, you can choose a different delivery day in your account settings. {3}, you may skip next week's box entirely at no charge. We are grateful for your {4} and wish you a happy holiday. — The FreshBox Team

gaps.why: Lịch giao của tuần tới (next week) → tương lai: will change.

o: All other delivery days will not be affected.
Monday deliveries have been very popular this year.
Deliveries will continue as usual on Monday.
Tuesday is the only day we cannot deliver.
gaps.a: All other delivery days will not be affected.
gaps.why: Vừa nói đơn thứ Hai dời sang thứ Ba → các ngày giao khác không đổi. "Thứ Hai vẫn giao như thường", "thứ Ba là ngày duy nhất không giao" trái với đoạn; câu đơn thứ Hai được ưa chuộng không nối với ý dời lịch.
Đưa ra một lựa chọn khác (bỏ qua hộp tuần tới thay vì đổi ngày) → Alternatively. Therefore / Consequently chỉ kết quả, không hợp.
your + danh từ: patience (sự kiên nhẫn). patients = bệnh nhân.

x.title: Food Distributor Opens Training Kitchen
x.text: Brennan Foods, the region's largest food distributor, opened a training kitchen at its headquarters last week. The kitchen, which {1} more than a year to build, will be used to teach cooking skills to local high school students who are interested in restaurant careers. Company president Lydia Brennan said the idea came from her own experience as a young cook. "Someone gave me a chance when I was seventeen," she said. {2} The program was funded with help from several local restaurants. Chefs from those restaurants will volunteer to {3} the classes. {4}, students who complete the twelve-week course will be offered paid summer jobs.

gaps.why: Bếp đã xây xong (mở tuần trước) → quá khứ: took.

o: She hopes the program will do the same for others.
The company plans to close the kitchen next year.
High school students are not eligible for the program.
Ms. Brennan has never worked in a restaurant.
gaps.a: She hopes the program will do the same for others.
gaps.why: Nối câu bà kể được cho cơ hội năm 17 tuổi → bà mong chương trình cũng cho người khác cơ hội như vậy. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn.
volunteer to + động từ nguyên mẫu: to lead.
Thêm một lợi ích nữa (việc làm hè có lương) → In addition.
